components.name: Button
components.description: Native button with the existing tinted capsule or filled/plain variants. Icon-only buttons need aria-label.

components.name: Hero
components.description: Large introductory title; shares the established large-title typography.

components.name: LargeTitle
components.description: The existing 34-point large app title. It wraps naturally at cover width.

components.name: List
components.description: Semantic list. Use Row as="li" for direct children, or place Sections inside list items.

components.name: NavigationLink
components.description: Keyboard-accessible push navigation. The destination renders inside a page with a back button.
components.props: type NavigationLinkProps = Omit<ButtonProps, 'onClick' | 'ref'> & { title: string; destination: ReactNode }

components.name: NavigationStack
components.description: Push navigation retaining the established Nav transition and useNavigation contract.

components.name: Placeholder
components.description: Centred empty, unavailable or loading content harvested from five existing apps.

components.name: Row
components.description: Grouped row with optional leading icon and trailing detail. Use as="button" for an action.

components.name: Screen
components.description: Scrolling app content. Exposes display metadata without opening a bridge or starting effects.

components.name: Section
components.description: Inset rounded group of rows, retaining the original grouped-list geometry.

components.name: Symbol
components.description: Decorative symbol inheriting text colour. Name the enclosing button when it is the only content.

components.name: Text
components.description: Inline text or formatted animated number. Caption reproduces the harvested secondary label.
components.props:
type TextProps<T extends ElementType = 'span'> = PrimitiveProps<T> & {
  size?: 'body' | 'caption' | 'footnote' | 'title'
  weight?: 'regular' | 'medium' | 'bold'
  color?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'accent'
  value?: number
  format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions
  suffix?: string
}

components.name: Title
components.description: Fixed app header, or its compact trailing accessories. Use as="h1" for a semantic heading.
components.props: type TitleProps<T extends ElementType = 'div'> = PrimitiveProps<T> & { variant?: 'header' | 'accessory' }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Native checkbox styled as the existing iOS switch. Supply a visible label or aria-label.

components.name: VStack
components.description: A shrinking vertical stack that fills its flex parent, including the cover display.

components.name: Widget
components.description: Host-rendered declarative snapshot. Refresh remains the app owner's responsibility.

components.name: WidgetLabel
components.description: Passive text label using existing widget typography; never fetches or schedules refreshes.
